title: Toggle Switch
text: Toggle parameter between two values, {Label} sets Block label position; {Connection} sets the block parameter value to connect parameter value connection and {States} sets the pair values and labels scalar and character. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Block parameter value to connect parameter value connection options

params.name: States
params.values: Pair values and labels scalar and character vector

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Top (default) | Bottom | Hide
